resources.string: AndroidHarness needs the microphone. Open the app, tap the mic in a chat once and allow it.
Pick a chat model in AndroidHarness first.
Could not send your question. Try again.
This is what was on the user\'s screen when they opened the assistant. The screenshot, if attached, shows the same screen.
Ask about any screen without leaving the app you are in
Long press the power or home button, or swipe up from a bottom corner, to ask about whatever is on screen.
Set AndroidHarness as your digital assistant app to turn this on
In Android settings, open Digital assistant app and pick AndroidHarness. Turn on Use text from screen and Use screenshot so it can see what you see.
The screen is captured only when you call the assistant, and it is sent to the model only when your question is about it. Apps that block screenshots stay hidden.
This phone does not let other apps be the digital assistant. That is a limit of the phone, not AndroidHarness. You can still ask about your screen by opening the app.
AndroidHarness is installed in a work profile, Secure Folder, Private Space or a second space. Only apps in your main profile can be the assistant, so install it there to use this.
On Samsung: Settings, then Apps, then Choose default apps, then Digital assistant app.
Cannot find it? Open Settings and search for digital assistant or assist. It is a different list from Voice input.
Details copied. Paste them into your report.
Listen as soon as the assistant opens. You can still switch to the keyboard.
Pick a model just for the assistant, like a fast one for quick questions. Chat keeps its own model.
How hard the assistant thinks before it answers. Each model uses its closest level, and models without levels decide for themselves.
When you ask out loud, the answer is read back with your text to speech voice.
Could not open Android settings. Look for Default apps, then Digital assistant app.
For models that cannot see images, the text in your pictures and screenshots is read on this phone and sent instead. Works offline.
This model cannot see images, so only the text in them is sent.
